fact.headline: Unofficial ATM finder — not a bank.
fact.body: atmchat helps you locate nearby ATMs from public OpenStreetMap amenity=atm data and opens them in Google Maps or Apple Maps. It is not a bank, does not dispense cash, and does not store proprietary bank ATM dumps. Verify fees and hours at the machine or with your bank.

outbound.headline: OpenStreetMap — amenity=atm
outbound.snippet: OSM wiki for the ATM tag. Coverage varies; contribute fixes on OSM, not by pasting bank dumps here.

outbound.headline: Fee + lighting beat a long walk
outbound.snippet: Neighbor tips: surcharge, vestibule hours, and whether the machine looked empty. Never post full card numbers or PINs.
